article.headline: Philadelphia faces conference foe Cleveland
article.title: Philadelphia faces conference foe Cleveland
article.story: Cleveland Cavaliers vs. Philadelphia 76ers Philadelphia; Thursday, 7 p.m. EDT LINE: 76ers -2.5; over/under is 235.5 BOTTOM LINE: Eastern Conference foes Philadelphia and Cleveland meet on Thursday. Philadelphia went 45-37 overall and 27-25 in Eastern Conference play last season. The 76ers averaged 18.9 points off of turnovers, 15.4 second-chance points and 32.4 bench points last season. Cleveland finished 52-30 overall and 33-19 in Eastern Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Cavaliers shot 48.2% from the field and 36.0% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: 76ers: Ariel Hukporti: out for season (achilles), Tacko Fall: out (hip), Dean Wade: out (ankle), Dominick Barlow: out (back). Cavaliers: Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
